description: List connected social accounts, initiate 1-click Managed OAuth 2.0 flows (`connect_oauth`), vault custom Bring-Your-Own-Keys (`connect_byok`) with zero markup and AES-256-GCM encryption, run live upstream API token health checks (`account_health`), or disconnect accounts across 18+ platforms. Use this tool whenever you need to link a new social network, verify OAuth token validity and latency, or inspect which platforms are ready for publishing. To reauthorize an existing connection (revoked refresh token, YouTube 401) without using a new plan seat, call connect_oauth with that account's `accountId` (and matching `platform`); example: accounts_manage({ action: "connect_oauth", platform: "youtube", accountId: "acc_youtube_718c0d", profileId: "<profile>" }) returns authorizationUrl even at Free 2/2. New connections still return a structured `PLAN_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED` upgrade prompt when the workspace quota is full.

accessToken.description: BYOK OAuth 2.0 Bearer access token, OAuth 1.0a access token, Telegram Bot token, or Discord Webhook URL encrypted at rest.

accountId.description: Connected social account identifier (e.g. 'acc_youtube_718c0d'). Required when `action` is 'disconnect' and optional filter for 'account_health'. For `connect_oauth`, pass the existing account id to reauthorize that connection (refresh a revoked token) in the same workspace; this does not consume a new plan seat. The account must belong to the authenticated workspace and `platform` (if passed) must match.

action.description: Account operation: 'list' connected accounts, 'connect_oauth' to get a 1-click OAuth 2.0 authorization URL (pass accountId to reauthorize an existing connection without consuming a new plan seat), 'connect_byok' to store custom API keys/tokens encrypted with AES-256-GCM ($0 markup), 'account_health'/'health_check' to verify live upstream token validity, or 'disconnect' to remove an account.

customClientId.description: BYOK OAuth App Client ID, API Key, Bot ID, or Bluesky identifier encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM in the Nuntior Vault (0% platform markup).

customClientSecret.description: BYOK OAuth App Client Secret, API Key Secret, or Bluesky App Password encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM in the Nuntior Vault.

platform.description: Target social, blog, or messaging platform slug (e.g. 'x', 'linkedin', 'bluesky', 'instagram', 'threads', 'youtube', 'tiktok', 'reddit'). Required for 'connect_oauth' and 'connect_byok'.

profileId.description: Brand profile identifier (e.g. 'prof_allometrik') that owns or filters the social account connections.

refreshToken.description: Optional OAuth 2.0 refresh token or OAuth 1.0a access token secret used for automatic token rotation and health recovery.

returnClientId.description: connect_oauth: your DCR OAuth client_id, used to allowlist an https returnTo.

returnTo.description: connect_oauth: where to send the user after connecting (relative path, agent deep link like cursor://, or an https origin registered in your OAuth client redirect_uris).

username.description: Account handle, username, Bluesky ATProto handle (e.g. 'brand.bsky.social'), or Mastodon instance handle associated with the social account.

name: accounts_manage
title: Manage Social OAuth & BYOK Accounts
